components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Ink-filled call to action; the single most important action on a screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: none; border-radius: 0.5rem; background: var(--color-primary); color: var(--color-primary-foreground); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ring); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Quiet warm-sand button for Cancel, Back, Close, Skip.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: none; border-radius: 0.5rem; background: var(--color-secondary); color: var(--color-secondary-foreground); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { opacity: 0.95; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Transparent fill with a hairline border; fills muted on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 0.5rem; background: transparent; color: var(--color-foreground); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--color-muted); } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Low-priority action; almost invisible until hovered.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: none; border-radius: 0.5rem; background: transparent; color: var(--color-foreground); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--color-muted); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Terracotta fill for destructive actions; kept rare.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: none; border-radius: 0.5rem; background: var(--color-destructive); color: var(--color-destructive-foreground); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-danger:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-danger:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Translucent paper field with a warm-gray hairline; ink ring on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--color-foreground); } .ds-input { height: 44px; width: 100%; padding: 10px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 0.5rem; background: var(--color-card); color: var(--color-foreground); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 14px; transition: border-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), box-shadow 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--color-muted-foreground); opacity: 0.6; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--color-ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--color-ring), 0 0 0 4px var(--color-background); } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Textarea
components.description: Generous writing field that resizes vertically.
components.css: .ds-textarea { min-height: 112px; width: 100%; padding: 12px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 0.5rem; background: var(--color-card); color: var(--color-foreground); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.625; resize: vertical; transition: border-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), box-shadow 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-textarea::placeholder { color: var(--color-muted-foreground); opacity: 0.6; } .ds-textarea:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--color-ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--color-ring), 0 0 0 4px var(--color-background); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Paper sheet on the page: soft surface, hairline border, serif title.
components.html:
Today's Reflection

A quiet moment to write.

Your most recent entry appears here.
components.css: .ds-card { border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 0.75rem; background: var(--color-card); color: var(--color-card-foreground); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); padding: 24px; font-family: var(--font-sans); transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), box-shadow 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), border-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-card-title { margin: 0 0 4px; font-family: var(--font-serif); font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.025em; line-height: 1.25; color: var(--color-foreground); } .ds-card-desc { margin: 0 0 16px; font-size: 14px; color: var(--color-muted-foreground); } .ds-card-body { font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.6; color: var(--color-foreground); }

components.name: Theme Toggle
components.description: Ghost icon button whose sun/moon swap as the theme flips.
components.html: <button class="ds-theme-toggle" aria-label="Toggle theme"><svg class="ds-sun" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="19" height="19" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="4"></circle><path d="M12 2v2M12 20v2M4.93 4.93l1.41 1.41M17.66 17.66l1.41 1.41M2 12h2M20 12h2M6.34 17.66l-1.41 1.41M19.07 4.93l-1.41 1.41"></path></svg><svg class="ds-moon" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="19" height="19" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M12 3a6 6 0 0 0 9 9 9 9 0 1 1-9-9Z"></path></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-theme-toggle { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 36px; height: 36px; border: none; border-radius: 0.5rem; background: transparent; color: var(--color-foreground); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-theme-toggle:hover { background: var(--color-muted); } .ds-theme-toggle:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ring); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-sun, .ds-moon { position: absolute; transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), opacity 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-moon { opacity: 0; transform: rotate(90deg) scale(0); } .dark .ds-sun, [data-theme="dark"] .ds-sun { opacity: 0; transform: rotate(-90deg) scale(0); } .dark .ds-moon, [data-theme="dark"] .ds-moon { opacity: 1; transform: rotate(0deg) scale(1); }

narrative.overview:
Withink is a private digital sanctuary for reflection — a leather journal in a warm reading room on a rainy Sunday afternoon. The interface does not perform; it recedes. Every screen is tuned for one outcome: the user forgets they are using software and keeps writing. Where productivity tools crowd the page, Withink breathes. Where social apps shout, Withink speaks at a murmur.

The visual language is warm, calm, minimal, human, and timeless. It is built on two material metaphors that never mix: paper and lamplight. In light mode the world is cream paper, brown ink, and a single warm amber accent — morning sunlight on a notebook. In dark mode it becomes a quiet library after hours: warm charcoal, cream text, and a softer amber glow — no pure black, no neon, no blue glare. The system is explicitly anti-futuristic, anti-corporate, anti-gamified; delight comes from quality (typography, spacing, reliable autosave), never gimmicks.

Two type families divide the labor cleanly: EB Garamond (serif) carries all display and heading text with a literary, editorial warmth, while Outfit (sans) carries body copy, UI labels, and navigation with quiet legibility. Hierarchy comes from size, weight, and spacing — never from bright color. Motion is fast (100–250ms), gentle, purposeful, and never playful. Buttons settle rather than jump; cards lift only a hairline; the theme change cross-fades like turning a page.
keyCharacteristics: Calm and minimal: generous whitespace, few elements, layouts that breathe (content capped at max-w-5xl, never full-bleed).
Warm and natural: ivory/charcoal surfaces, brown-ink and cream text, a single amber accent used sparingly.
Editorial typography: serif headlines (EB Garamond) over sans body (Outfit), hierarchy by size and spacing, not color.
Depth through hairlines, not shadows: cards are flat at rest, softly lifted only on interaction, shadowed strongly only for overlays.
Quiet and tactile interactions: fade hovers, a subtle press (scale(0.98)), fast 200ms transitions, View-Transition cross-fade on theme change.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Warm amber is the system's only accent color. It appears in ≤5% of any screen: text selection, the caret, an interactive card's hover border, the blockquote rail. No secondary accent is ever introduced.

rules.name: The Low-Strain Rule
rules.body: All surfaces and text sit in a warm, low-chroma band. Never ship pure white, pure black, or saturated blue anywhere in either theme — eye comfort is a product feature.

rules.name: The Serif Headline Rule
rules.body: EB Garamond is for display and headings only. Body copy, labels, navigation, and buttons are always Outfit. Never set a paragraph in the serif and never set a label in the serif.

rules.name: The Hierarchy-by-Spacing Rule
rules.body: Headings never exceed weight 700, and hierarchy is carried by size and spacing rather than by color or extra-bold weights. Bold is a tool, not an exclamation point.

rules.name: The Breathe Rule
rules.body: Never fill empty space and never compress a layout to fit more content. If a screen looks sparse, the answer is better typography and spacing, not more elements.

rules.name: The No-Floating-Cards Rule
rules.body: Cards at rest are flat paper with a hairline border. Shadows are earned by interaction or by being an overlay; a static card that hovers above the page is a defect.

rules.name: The 250ms Rule
rules.body: All theme/color transitions run at 250ms with standard easing (cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)); no transition ever exceeds 300ms. Motion communicates, never entertains.

rules.name: The Soft Corner Rule
rules.body: Sharp 0px corners and exaggerated pill radii are both forbidden. Every control sits somewhere in the 0.375–0.875rem band, or is fully round for a deliberately circular element (avatar, mood dot).

dos: Do keep every surface and text color in the warm, low-chroma band — no pure white, pure black, or saturated blue.
Do use EB Garamond for headings and Outfit for body/labels, and let spacing and weight (max 700) carry hierarchy.
Do let cards rest flat on their hairline border, lifting only on hover and only for real overlays.
Do keep page content to max-w-5xl and writing to max-w-3xl — whitespace is content.
Do reserve the amber accent for ≤5% of any screen and reserve terracotta for destructive actions.
Do keep motion fast (100–250ms, standard easing) and use it to communicate state, never to entertain.
donts: Don't add a second accent color, neon tones, or any futuristic/cyberpunk/corporate styling.
Don't set body text or labels in the serif font.
Don't float static cards with heavy shadows or let shadows appear without an interaction or overlay reason.
Don't crowd the page — never fill empty space or compress layouts to fit more content.
Don't use more than one primary button per section, or use danger styling for non-destructive actions.
Don't exceed 300ms on any animation or apply it where reduced motion is preferred.
